fleet-manager-onboarding-desktop.purpose: Coordinate desktop setup for a fleet manager: workspace profile, fleet import, permissions, review, and first dashboard readiness.
useWhen: A manager must configure several operational prerequisites before using a workspace.
Setup includes imported data, roles, policy review, and recovery states.
The system is reusable across desktop onboarding surfaces, not a final product template.
doNotUseWithoutReview: A single settings form is enough.
Role policy, import validation, or ownership rules are unclear.
The request describes a full dashboard screen or product IA template.
foundations: Desktop layout separates setup controls, preview, and review without nested cards.
Draft, importing, validating, reviewing, complete, empty, and error are explicit.
Setup copy names operational consequences plainly.
Permission details can open in overlays without losing setup state.
Tables, checkboxes, and stepper state are keyboard readable.
Design System semantic tones communicate progress, warning, and success.
motion: Stepper and panel update after user action.
Inline Validation appears only after failed action.
Panel changes stay immediate and readable.
accessibility: Table preview is labeled and has readable columns.
Permission choices use real checkbox controls.
Save/import feedback does not steal focus.
tests: Continue advances setup after user action.
Desktop and narrow layouts avoid overflow.

canDecide: Use this pattern for reusable desktop onboarding setup before templates.
Compose Design System fields, select, table, KPI, checkbox, badge, button, and toast.
Keep import and permission rules explicit.
mustAsk: Role model, import source, data validation, region policy, or completion criteria is unclear.
rejectIf: It becomes a full dashboard template.
Tables, buttons, or fields are custom hardcoded substitutes.
Permissions are shown without real controls.
miel.handoff: Confirm workspace fields, import source, role policy, validation rules, owner, completion criteria, and template handoff.
